offers_products.reason: Manufactures automotive locks, keys, latches, power access systems and smart key fobs.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured access components; engineering support is part of product development, not a separate main service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells mainly to automotive OEMs; aftermarket goes through distributors and locksmiths, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are automotive OEMs, plus aftermarket distributors and locksmiths.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat production orders from OEMs on multi-year vehicle programs, plus ongoing aftermarket lock and key sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand follows new vehicle production, which falls sharply in downturns as car purchases are postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Locks, latches and keys are low-priced components ordered in high volume and frequently.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured locks, latches and electronic access hardware, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large automakers (OEMs) such as major global vehicle manufacturers.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs multiple manufacturing plants for locks, latches and power access; needs continuing tooling and plant investment.

notes: Customer names are not listed on the site text; OEM customers are inferred from references to OEMs and my own knowledge.
